The '''Turbodyne 1220 drop ship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
At the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|Battle of Sebaddon]], a Turbodyne 1220 crashed into a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[NR2 gully jumper|NR2 light transport]] during its assault run on the [[Fastbreeder|Hex]] forces.
